## Loading Packages
```{r load-packages, message=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(scales)
```

## Global Themes 
```{r global-theme, message=FALSE}
viz_theme <- theme_classic() + 
             theme(legend.text = element_text(size = 12, color = "black", family = "serif"),
                   legend.title = element_text(size = 12, color = "black", family = "serif"),
                   axis.text = element_text(size = 10, color = "black", family = "serif"),
                   axis.title = element_text(size = 12, color = "black", family = "serif"))

```

## Importing Data
```{r data, message=FALSE}
# Subset data
doc_data <- read.csv("data/s2_data_clean.csv")

# Meta-analyses
included_ma <- read.csv("data/ma_data.csv")

# Codebook 1
codebook_1 <- read.csv("data/Codebook_1_clean.csv")
```

```{r country-list}
practice <- doc_data %>% 
  select(id, unique_id)

practice_dedupe <- practice[!duplicated(practice$unique_id),]

practice_docs <- practice %>%
  pull(unique_id)

country <- codebook_1 %>% 
  select(unique_ID, cite_country, cite_lang) %>% 
  mutate(unique_id = unique_ID) %>% 
  mutate(prac_yes = ifelse(unique_id %in% practice_docs, "Yes", "No")) %>% 
  filter(prac_yes == "Yes")

country_dedupe <- country[!duplicated(country$unique_id),]
```

```{r countries}
table(country_dedupe$cite_country)

table(country_dedupe$cite_lang)
```
